Text and data mining to develop or train AI models is reserved absent prior written permission. This concerns the repository Software, not third-party components under separate terms.
clauses.condition_explanation: The reading and study permission is limited to those purposes. AI-development or training text-and-data mining is allowed only if the licensor has given prior written permission.

clauses.scope_note: Applies to the repository Software and only to a licensee holding a valid Agentic Team subscription or trial license; the duration, scope, purpose, and designated environments are bounded by the license and licensor documentation.
clauses.condition_explanation: All listed conditions apply: the license must remain valid, use must stay within its duration and scope, occur on the licensee’s own systems in documented designated environments, and be for the offered purpose.

clauses.clause_label: 3(a) No third-party making available or resale without consent
clauses.scope_note: A licensee may not republish, resell, sublicense, rent, host for third parties, or otherwise make the Software or a substantial part available to third parties, whether modified or not, absent prior written permission. This does not establish a general prohibition on activities involving unrelated artifacts.

clauses.clause_label: 3(b) No incorporation of protected expression into offerings to others; ideas-and-principles exception
clauses.scope_note: Without prior written licensor consent, the licensee may not take the Software or substantial parts into a product or service offered to others than its own organization. The restriction covers copyright-protected expression, including source code, agent definitions, schemas, prompts, and texts; it does not restrict discovering and applying underlying ideas and principles. The clause does not state a general ban on commercial use apart from this specified incorporation and offering.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies only when both the protected expression is taken wholly or substantially and the resulting product or service is offered outside the licensee’s own organization, absent prior written permission. Applying underlying ideas or principles is expressly outside this restriction.

clauses.scope_note: The restriction concerns the repository Software and access to the licensor’s services through it.
clauses.condition_explanation: Either circumvention of a technical or contractual restriction, including a license or access control, or use of the Software to obtain service access without a valid license triggers the prohibition.

clauses.clause_label: 3(d) Reverse engineering restriction and statutory exceptions
clauses.scope_note: Prohibits reverse engineering, decompilation, or disassembly of components not available as readable source in the repository, while preserving the stated rights of a lawful acquirer: loading, displaying, and correcting errors; making a backup copy; observing, studying, and testing to discover underlying ideas and principles; and decompiling to the extent indispensable for interoperability. The text also states that a term conflicting with the specified statutory rights under Articles 45k, 45l, or 45m is void.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies to reverse engineering, decompilation, or disassembly of a non-readable-source component only insofar as the conduct is not within a preserved mandatory-law right. The listed statutory exceptions remain applicable.

clauses.clause_label: 3(e) No removal, alteration, or confusing use of licensor marks and notices
clauses.scope_note: The prohibition applies to the licensor’s marks, names, logos, and copyright notices on or associated with the Software.
clauses.condition_explanation: Either removing or altering the listed identifiers, or using them in a manner capable of causing confusion about origin, is prohibited.

clauses.clause_label: 6 Termination; continuing source inspection and third-party forks
clauses.scope_note: The section 2(b) use right and 2(c) copying right end automatically when the Agentic Team license ends or when a section 3 breach is not cured within 14 days after notice. The section 2(a) source-inspection right remains while the licensor keeps the repository public. Platform-created forks remain subject to this license, but the licensor says it cannot end their availability.
clauses.condition_explanation: Either license expiry or an uncured section 3 breach after the 14-day post-notice cure period ends the section 2(b) and 2(c) rights. Public source-inspection access continues only while the repository remains public.
